start.title: On the Road
start.text:
The pilgrims walk toward Jerusalem.
The feast of Passover draws near.

choices.text: Run ahead alone, far from them

choices.feedback: Luke 2:41-42 — Jesus' parents traveled to Jerusalem every year for the Passover, and Jesus went with them.

choices.text: Refuse to go to the feast

stray_consequence.title: Walk Together
stray_consequence.text:
The road is long and crowded.
Stay near your parents.

refuse_consequence.title: Honor the Feast
refuse_consequence.text:
Passover is the holy memory of God.
You must go.

temple.title: The Temple Courts
temple.text:
Sunlight falls on the great stones.
Voices of teachers fill the air.

choices.text: Enter and listen to the teachers
choices.feedback: Luke 2:46 — After three days, Mary and Joseph found Jesus in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.

market_consequence.title: His Father's House
market_consequence.text:
The temple is your true place.
Go where wisdom is spoken.

choices.text: Enter and listen to the teachers

stay.title: When the Caravan Leaves
stay.text:
The pilgrims begin to depart.
The teachers still speak of God.

choices.text: Stay to hear the words of God
choices.feedback: Luke 2:43 — When the feast was over, while his parents were returning home, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem.

choices.text: Hide in the streets to play

follow_consequence.title: Stay and Learn
follow_consequence.text:
The Father's house holds you.
You are meant to remain.

choices.text: Stay to hear the words of God

hide_consequence.title: Sacred Time
hide_consequence.text:
Wisdom does not wait for play.
Return to the temple.

choices.text: Stay to hear the words of God

search.title: They Are Searching
search.text:
Three days pass in the temple.
Mary and Joseph walk Jerusalem in fear.

choices.text: Slip away and hide from them
Remain where they will find you
choices.feedback: Luke 2:46 — After three days, Mary and Joseph found Jesus in the temple courts.

flee_consequence.title: Be Found
flee_consequence.text:
They love you and seek you.
Wait where you belong.

choices.text: Remain where they will find you

teachers.title: Among the Wise
teachers.text:
The elders ask many questions.
They wait for your answer.

choices.feedback: Luke 2:47 — Everyone who heard Jesus was amazed at his understanding and his answers.

silent_consequence.title: Speak Gently
silent_consequence.text:
Truth lives within you.
Let it be heard.

choices.feedback: Your soft voice fills the room.

boast_consequence.title: Be Humble
boast_consequence.text:
Wisdom is not for boasting.
Speak with quiet grace.

reunion.title: Mary Finds You
reunion.text:
She weeps:
"Why have you done this to us?"

choices.feedback: Luke 2:49 — Jesus asked his parents, "Why were you searching for me? Didn't you know I had to be in my Father's house?"
Do not run from her love.

blame_consequence.title: Speak with Love
blame_consequence.text:
She is your mother.
Answer her with grace.

shame_consequence.title: Stay With Her
shame_consequence.text:
She has searched three days.
Give her the truth.

return.title: Home to Nazareth
return.text:
You walk with them under the dawn.
You grow in wisdom and grace.
